text:
lucy (support): FYI customer ACME reported repeated rerank 504s and occasional 502s starting ~09:20 UTC when their job fanout jumped. They see p95 latency spike from ~120ms -> 2.3s and then gateway timeouts. stack trace attached in ticket.
sam (support): what's their qps and payload shape? any big candidate lists?
lucy (support): they're sending bulk rerank with ~350 candidates per request. each candidate has long metadata blobs. qps peaked at ~1.6k across the org key. auth looks fine (token valid).
andre (eng-sre): can you paste the gateway logs? do we see upstream read timeout  or 502 from backend?
lucy (support): logs: "upstream read timeout from http://rerank-backend:8080, client_req_id=xyz, status=504". Also some 502s with "connection reset by peer". Ticket includes sample request body.
maria (eng-runtime): 350 candidates is above the usual heavy fanout. Reranker used to be configured with candidate_limit=200 in the routing layer; if client sends more it fans out and creates large batches that blow up kv-cache and batch queueing. Also long metadata increases serialization time. Did we recently roll a runtime change?
ben (ml-infra): We deployed a kernel perf update at 08:55 UTC (deploy-bot below). That increased per-token CPU for long metadata deserial because of extra validation. Might exacerbate the tail under big batches.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: eng-runtime v3.14.1 at 08:55 UTC — rollout 100%.
andre (eng-sre): repro steps suggested: 1) send a synthetic payload with 350 short candidates vs 350 long candidates to compare. 2) ramp qps to 1.6k with small bursts. We should capture per-worker queue lengths and KV cache hit/miss.
lucy (support): customer willing to repro in our staging if we give them a dedicated token. They want a quick mitigation — put them on a rate limit for now?
sam (support): suggest soft throttle: reduce their concurrency and set per-route max_in_flight to 8 for that org key. That buys time while we debug.
maria (eng-runtime): temporary mitigations: - enforce candidate_limit=200 at gateway (reject with 400 and helpful message) - enable prefix/KV cache prefetching for common prefixes - reduce max_batch_size for rerank model variant to avoid huge batches
ben (ml-infra): quick patch: we can turn on conservative batch sizing for the rerank worker pool via feature flag. That will lower throughput but reduce p95 dramatically.
andre (eng-sre): also review retry policy. A lot of client retries are causing thundering herd. If gateway returns 429 with Retry-After early, clients back off. We should avoid silent retries that requeue to backend immediately.
lucy (support): i filed an emergency config request to ops to lower their qps quota and enforce candidate_limit for their org — ticket #T-4821.
ben (ml-infra): can someone attach the minimal curl that reproduces? i'll run it with profiling.
lucy (support): sample (sanitized): ```curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"candidates": [ {"id":"c1","text":"...","metadata":"<large blob>"}, ... 350 entries], "query":"best result" }'``` note: they batch 350 in one call and do ~5 concurrent calls from many clients.
andre (eng-sre): action items: 1) ops: apply per-org soft throttle + candidate_limit 200 (lucy) 2) ml-infra: flip conservative batch sizing flag (ben) 3) runtime: revert or hotfix the validation perf change if reproduces (maria) 4) support: keep customer notified and offer staging repro (sam)
sam (support): i'll message customer and request permission for staging token. I'll also ask them to reduce candidates while we triage.
maria (eng-runtime): for the long term, we should add server-side guardrails: reject >250 candidates, stream candidate processing, and add a lightweight metadata size cap. I'll open a design doc.
ben (ml-infra): run done locally: synthetic 350-candidates with long metadata reproduced 504 at qps ~1.2k (one worker). With conservative batch sizing flag on, p95 dropped from 2.1s -> 140ms, no 504s in test run.
andre (eng-sre): good. ops please proceed with soft throttle and candidate_limit change. Also enable extra logging on rerank worker queue lengths and KV cache eviction events.
lucy (support): ops confirmed change applied at 09:56 UTC for that org key. customer reports immediate reduction in 504s but some increased 429s while they throttle down.
sam (support): customer accepted staging token and will repro with smaller candidates list first.
maria (eng-runtime): i'll file a revert PR for the perf validation and a follow-up that adds a feature-flagged rollout path for it.
ben (ml-infra): followup: we'll also add an adaptive fallback to a lower-cost model variant when queue depth > threshold to avoid full outages.
lucy (support): thanks team. i'll close the customer escalation once they confirm stable in 24h. copying ticket #T-4821 into this thread for trace.
sam (support): :thumbsup: keep me posted if any rollback needed.
andre (eng-sre): closing notes: root cause = combination of large candidate fanout + recent runtime perf change + client retries. Mitigations applied: per-org soft throttle, candidate_limit enforcement, conservative batching flag. Next: metric alert for rerank p95 and queue-depth > 70%.
lucy (support): noted. closing thread after 24h watch.
